purpose: Meticulous re-review of coordinated or potentially coordinated hand contact and manipulation following user feedback on multimeter task.
required_checks: Each hand anatomical identity and contact part
Support versus proximity and active manipulation

reviews.previous_prompt: The humanoid uses its left hand to grasp a near tripod leg and its right hand to support the central frame. Both hands raise and rotate the tripod from its tilted position into an upright stance, guiding its spread feet onto the desk. It releases the tripod and withdraws both hands, leaving it standing unsupported. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

The right hand releases the meter into the basket and withdraws, leaving the meter settled inside.
